findings.title: Prompt file at skill root: .memlog.md
findings.evidence: path-standards reports high: .memlog.md sits at skill root (only SKILL.md allowed). Pre-pass: 1 structure finding. Same builder process-memory convention as team-ready/team-gates; not workflow content, but the scanner still fails the skill.

findings.title: Opportunity: path-aware soft-gate (don't re-offer unfinished)
findings.evidence: Soft-gate elicitation after the board always offers unfinished when sprint exists, but Open-floor opening already invites unfinished on the underspecified path when sprint exists; empty_fleet still gets unfinished/explain while soft_offer is team-gates define.
findings.recommendation: One soft-gate: offer unfinished only if sprint exists and unfinished was not already decided (open-floor or --include-unfinished); offer explain only when blocked; else proceed via script soft_offer. Skip soft-gate on empty_fleet.
